job.summary: We are looking for a Senior Data Engineer to build and operate batch and streaming data pipelines for our retail analytics platform. The ideal candidate will have strong Python and SQL skills, experience with Apache Spark and Airflow, and proficiency in AWS cloud services. Responsibilities include designing ETL/ELT pipelines, optimizing Spark jobs, and mentoring junior engineers.

structured_cv.summary: Priya Sharma is a Senior Data Engineer with 7 years of experience building robust data platforms for e-commerce and retail. She has a strong background in developing scalable PySpark pipelines, orchestrating data workflows with Apache Airflow, and managing cloud infrastructure on AWS. Her expertise spans data warehousing, streaming ingestion with Kafka, and implementing data quality and transformation tools like dbt and Great Expectations. She also brings leadership experience from mentoring junior engineers.

strengths: 100% match on required must-have skills including extensive PySpark, Airflow, and AWS ecosystem tools
Strong track record in retail/e-commerce data platforms processing multi-terabyte pipelines at ShopMart
Demonstrated mentorship capability and direct experience leading data quality initiatives with Great Expectations and dbt
Exceeds experience requirement with 7 years of relevant data engineering tenure
risks: No significant technical risks identified; profile represents an exceptionally close alignment
ranked_candidates.explanation: Priya Sharma is an exemplary fit for the Senior Data Engineer position, satisfying 100% of the must-have technical requirements and nearly all nice-to-have proficiencies. With 7 years of progressive experience, she has directly performed every primary job duty, including architecting large-scale PySpark pipelines on AWS EMR, managing 120+ Airflow DAGs, and handling Redshift migrations. Her background at ShopMart provides direct retail and e-commerce domain experience, aligning seamlessly with the team's analytics focus. Additionally, she demonstrates proven leadership through mentoring junior engineers and institutionalizing automated data quality checks. Her educational background in Computer Science from IIT Delhi perfectly satisfies the degree prerequisite. Overall, her profile presents immediate readiness and high capability with minimal ramp-up time.
ranked_candidates.calibration_note: Unambiguous top candidate meeting all must-have technical requirements with 7 years of directly relevant senior-level experience.
